hotels.title: Southern California Oceanfront Escape on Huntington Beach with Daily US$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: This oceanfront escape is the quintessential Southern California stay, overlooking the golden sands of Huntington Beach and with Disneyland a 30-minute drive away. Wake to sweeping Pacific views before letting the kids roam free between two sparkling pools complete with waterslides and shaded cabanas. Spend sun-filled days by the water, then gather together around a private beachfront fire pit as the sky turns golden and the Pacific waves roll in. Daily US$50 dining credit means you'll be able to dine as you like across the resort’s five restaurants and bars, from ice-cold martinis at Offshore 9 Rooftop Lounge to open-air dining at Henry’s Coastal Cuisine Restaurant.
